en.name: Shopping comparison
en.description: Agents research; you choose. Compare matching offers with coupon conditions, shipping, sources and observation times. Save candidates, add shared notes and link to a comparison. No built-in marketplace login or automatic scraping.

zh.name: 购物比价
zh.description: agent 查价，你来选：并排查看同款报价、优惠条件、运费、来源和查询时间，收藏候选并记录购买考虑。支持分享直达；不内置电商登录或自动抓价。
